# Key Findings (auto-generated)

Factual rollup of the current feature dataset. Interpretation lives in the final report.

## Overview
- Posts: 62,299 across 2 platforms (youtube: 53,140, instagram: 9,159).
- Content date range: 2016-04-20 to 2026-10-18.

## Sentiment by platform (English)
- instagram: positive 84.9%, neutral 7.6%, negative 7.5%.
- youtube: positive 61.2%, neutral 22.0%, negative 16.8%.

## Engagement vs sentiment
- Avg engagement percentile by sentiment: negative 0.487, neutral 0.495, positive 0.505 (spread 0.018).
- Relationship is essentially flat (sentiment does not predict engagement).

## Dominant topics (by volume)
- T0: business, time, build, real - 43,652 posts.
- T3: chat, gpt, chat gpt, claude - 3,076 posts.
- T4: course, hi, engineer, step - 2,709 posts.
- T2: free, free praise, praise, paid - 1,375 posts.
- T1: clear, wish, understandable, clear understandable - 1,126 posts.

## Emerging vs declining topics (recent vs earlier in window)
- Rising: T0: business, time, build, real (+3.56 pts).
- Rising: T3: chat, gpt, chat gpt, claude (+0.41 pts).
- Rising: T2: free, free praise, praise, paid (-0.26 pts).
- Declining: T5: explaining, smart, crisp, necessary sufficient (-1.31 pts).
- Declining: T4: course, hi, engineer, step (-1.42 pts).

## Top keywords (by volume)
- ChatGPT - 12,460 posts.
- AI Agents - 10,201 posts.
- Automation - 6,676 posts.
- Startup - 6,016 posts.
- SEO - 4,922 posts.

## Models
- Production sentiment model: vader (deploy-domain macro-F1 0.6493).
- Topic model: NMF, k=6, UMass coherence -0.6952 (more coherent than LDA).
